text:
gina: Quick planning note for the upcoming external PT. We need a compact checklist for squads: evidence shape, KMS proxy rules, RBAC snapshots, and retest gating.

omar: Agreed. Minimal evidence shape = ndjson.gz inside a tar.gz, flat manifest.csv, SHA256SUMS, and a detached .sig. Manifest must be one line per file, flat columns only.

sanjay: KMS handling: do not expose key ARNs. Use decrypt-proxy which mints a decrypt-session token scoped to artifact_id and assessor_role. Proxy streams plaintext over mTLS and logs a metadata-only audit event.

gina: Token TTL default 4h. Extension requires both eng-security and infra-oncall approval; approvals get recorded as approver_id + ts in manifest. No silent extensions.

omar: RBAC snapshot requirement: record role_snapshot_before and role_snapshot_after for any pt-assessor grant. Include in audit and echo into the manifest under `role_before` and `role_after`.

sanjay: Retest gating: bot will auto-label `ready-for-retest` when manifest.csv, SHA256SUMS, .sig, and a remediation PR link are present and CI has two passing runs. Once labeled, scheduler offers +7d and +21d slots.

gina: Add a canary flow: teams can request a canary retest at +3d for critical fixes but must include a short repro script and get infra-oncall approval recorded in manifest.

omar: Provide squads this example export command to standardize outputs:
```bash
./pt-export --from 2026-08-01T02:00:00Z --to 2026-08-01T06:00:00Z --out /tmp/pt.tar.gz \
  --exporter-sha=abcd1234 && sha256sum /tmp/pt.tar.gz > /tmp/SHA256SUMS
```

sanjay: Audit retention: evidence objects 90 days, immutable audit 18 months. Also snapshot a hashed index to coldstore monthly with legal hold for long-term forensics.

gina: Action items: Omar - publish manifest template + sample; Sanjay - build decrypt-proxy audit hook; I'll update the GitHub issue template to require EXPORTER_SHA and manifest_id. Dry-run scheduled Fri 2026-08-12 15:00 UTC.

infra-oncall: Acknowledged. We'll be on the dry-run and will validate extension flow.

pt-bot: Reminder: engagement "halcyon" kickoff 2026-08-15T09:00:00Z. Ephemeral roles provision 20m prior.

gina: Thanks team — keep dry-run messages short so the verifier output is readable. :thumbsup:
